atoms.name: Entropy
atoms.one_line: $H=-\sum p_k\log_2p_k$; 0 for a pure node, $\log_2K$ at uniform.

atoms.name: Gini impurity
atoms.one_line: $1-\sum p_k^2$; 0 for pure, $0.5$ max for two classes.

atoms.name: Information gain
atoms.one_line: Parent impurity minus size-weighted child impurity.

atoms.name: Choosing the split
atoms.one_line: Greedy: take the attribute (or threshold) with highest gain; stop at pure nodes.

atoms.name: Leaf prediction and training error
atoms.one_line: Leaf predicts the majority class; error is the minority fraction.

atoms.name: Capacity and overfitting
atoms.one_line: A deep tree fits XOR and any consistent data; pruning trades bias for variance.
